title: 第934章 荒仙纪元出事了第933章 空天帝
lines: 与此同时。
无归界难以想象的最深处禁忌区域。
这里，是整个无归界最尊贵、最古老、最神秘、最高远的至尊区域。
寻常的不祥半步超脱，连踏入此地的资格都没有。
一座由无尽的不祥气息凝聚而成的宏伟而古老的宫殿，静静矗立在黑暗的最深处。
宫殿通体漆黑，没有任何光泽，仿佛能吞噬一切光线与灵魂。
宫殿的轮廓在黑暗中若隐若现，如同蛰伏的太古巨兽，散发着令人心悸的恐怖气息。
宫殿最深处，那最尊贵的区域，盘坐着好几道散发着无限恐怖气息的盖世生灵。
他们的身影都笼罩在浓郁的黑雾之中，看不真切面容。
可以确定的是，这几个生灵中的任何一个，其气息都要远超普通的超脱者！
他们，赫然已经在超脱这个境界走到了不可思议、难以想象的逆天程度！
绝对是永恒超脱之境！
跟那十二尊普通的超脱者已经有了难以想象的云泥之别！
此刻他们好像在交谈着什么。
时不时有冰冷且沙哑的声音响起，在空旷的大殿之中回荡，带着令人毛骨悚然的寒意。
“吾不明白，为何不战？”
左侧一道身影率先开口，声音粗重，带着毫不掩饰的杀意和愤怒：
“吾等九个联手，未必不能和他一战！”
“同为永恒超脱之境，吾就不信，真的就敌不过他？”
“吾等哪一个不是堪比纪元最强者级别？哪怕是堆数量也能堆死他！哼！”
第二道声音响起，同样沙哑而冰冷，带着不满的杀意和怨念。
他身上的气息暴动，引得整个宫殿都微微颤抖起来。
显然，对于撤军的命令，他们非常不服气。
在他们看来，空虽强，可他们人多。
九对一，胜算极大。
没必要如此畏首畏尾，平白错失了踏平诸天万界的良机。
微微沉默片刻之后。
那最中央的那个漆黑生灵终于开口。
他的声音更加低沉，更加古老，仿佛从万古之前传来，带着不容置疑的威严。
他一开口，其他几个全都保持了沉默。
“那位伟大存在降下的法旨，不是吾等可以非议的。”
“不过，本尊可以透露一点。”
“荒仙纪元出事了。”
“我们的伟大计划，遭遇到了难以想象的阻力。”
“荒仙纪元出现了难以想象的惊天变数。”
此言一出，其余几道身影皆是一震。
荒仙纪元？
那个早已覆灭、被他们彻底掌控的纪元，怎么会出变数？
“本次撤退，乃是权宜之计。”
中央的身影继续缓缓说道，语气带着一切尽在掌握的笃定：
content_en:
at the same time.
The unimaginable deepest forbidden area of ​​No Return.
This is the most noble, ancient, mysterious, and far-reaching supreme area in the entire No Return Realm.
The ordinary and ominous half-step of transcendence is not even qualified to step into this place.
A majestic and ancient palace condensed with endless ominous atmosphere, standing quietly in the deepest part of the darkness.
The palace was completely dark, without any luster, as if it could swallow up all light and soul.
The outline of the palace loomed in the darkness, like a dormant ancient beast, exuding a heart-stopping and terrifying aura.
In the deepest part of the palace, in the most noble area, sat several unparalleled creatures exuding infinite terror.
Their figures were shrouded in thick black mist, making it difficult to see their true faces.
What is certain is that the aura of any one of these creatures is far superior to that of an ordinary transcendent person!
They have reached an incredible and unimaginable level of transcendence!
It is definitely a state of eternal transcendence!
There is an unimaginable difference from the twelve ordinary transcendent beings!
They seemed to be talking about something at this moment.
From time to time, a cold and hoarse voice sounded, echoing in the empty hall, with a chilling chill.
"I don't understand, why don't you fight?"
A figure on the left spoke first, with a thick voice and undisguised murderous intent and anger:
"If the nine of us join forces, we may not be able to fight him!"
"I don't believe that we are both in the realm of eternal transcendence. Are we really no match for him?"
"Which one of us is not comparable to the strongest person in the era? Even the number of them can kill him! Humph!"
The second voice sounded, equally hoarse and cold, with dissatisfied killing intent and resentment.
The aura on his body was rioting, causing the entire palace to tremble slightly.
Obviously, they were very unconvinced by the order to withdraw their troops.
In their opinion, although Kong is stronger, they have more people.
Nine against one, the odds of winning are extremely high.
There is no need to be so timid, and you will miss the opportunity to conquer all the worlds.
After a moment of slight silence.
The dark creature in the center finally spoke.
His voice was deeper and older, as if it came from eons ago, with unquestionable majesty.
As soon as he opened his mouth, the others all remained silent.
"The decree issued by that great being is not something we can criticize."
"However, I can reveal a little bit."
"Something happened in the Desolate Immortal Era."
"Our great plan has encountered unimaginable resistance."
"Unimaginable and shocking changes occurred in the Desolate Immortal Era."
As soon as these words came out, the other figures were shocked.
The Era of Desolate Immortals?
How could something change in that era that had long been destroyed and was completely controlled by them?
"This retreat is a temporary measure."
The figure in the center continued to speak slowly, with a tone of certainty that everything was under control:
